title: One-Step Equations: Multiplication & Division

copy.studentInstructions: Solve each one-step equation for x. Use division to undo multiplication, or multiplication to undo division. Mark the value of x in the called column.
copy.roomIntro: 50 process-focused equations. M and A: divide to solve. T and H: multiply to solve. O: multiply by the reciprocal of a fractional coefficient. Includes negatives, simple decimals, and simple fractions.
copy.callerSubtitle: Use the inverse operation. Watch the signs.
copy.joinIntro: Enter your teacher’s room code to join.
copy.footer: Use the inverse operation. Solve for x.
copy.bankIntro: 10 equations per column, all using x. M and A have integer coefficients and are solved by division. T and H have x divided by an integer and are solved by multiplication. O has fractional coefficients. Answers stay within manageable integers, terminating decimals, and simple reduced fractions. Signed-in edits save to your private teacher library.

caller.default: Solve for x. Mark its value in column {letter}.
